storage.notes: Has a 3.5" SATA HDD bay; sold with or without a pre-installed 2TB HDD and supports HDDs up to 16TB. Also has one microSD slot up to 512GB, but microSD cannot record while an HDD is installed. AES-128 encrypted local storage; no cloud subscription required.

features: Wireless Security Center / NVR hub for Reolink WiFi/battery/PoE cameras — not a standalone camera
hosts its own dual-band 2.4/5GHz Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) access point for connected cameras
uplinks to the router via wired Ethernet (dedicated WAN RJ45)
second RJ45 port for wired IP cameras
3.5" SATA HDD bay (up to 16TB) + optional 2TB HDD; one microSD slot up to 512GB
AI-powered local video search, no subscription fee, no cloud required
provides RTSP/RTMP re-streaming access to its connected cameras (the hub has no camera stream of its own)
NVR/hub accessory — camera-specific schema fields (lens, resolution, night vision) do not apply
release_notes: Reolink's higher-capacity NVR/hub accessory (used with Reolink WiFi/battery/PoE cameras for local storage + AI features without a cloud subscription), not a camera. The camera schema is a poor fit: resolution/lens/night_vision/field_of_view describe the hub itself, which has no image sensor. 'type': 'box' is used only because the schema has no dedicated hub/NVR enum value. 'connectivity' reflects only the hub's own wired uplink (dedicated WAN RJ45); it separately hosts a private Wi-Fi 6 access point for its cameras and has a second RJ45 for wired IP cameras. No official IP rating is published for this indoor-only device, so ip_rating is left unset.
